move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
We gladly accept your proposal of 14-day payment terms and have reduced our price to €15.80 per unit accordingly.
To keep the price as competitive as possible, we have maintained EXW delivery, as DAP and shorter lead times would significantly increase the unit cost.
We appreciate your commitment to a binding volume of 6,000 pieces; could you please share the expected delivery schedules to confirm this?
Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.80 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
